open_points.subject: wall-clock readings for a revision-moving operation
open_points.text: sets its last-changed instant to the current instant
open_points.question: How many UTC wall-clock readings does one accepted revision-moving operation take, and is one reading shared by the record's last-changed instant, the audit entry's instant and any other instants written by that operation?
options: Take one UTC wall-clock reading and use it for every instant written by the operation.
Take a separate UTC wall-clock reading for each written instant.
Take one reading for the record change and a separate reading for its audit entry.
open_points.default_guess: Take one UTC wall-clock reading after all checks pass and share it across every instant written atomically by the operation.

witness.initial: An active project is at revision 4, and its last-changed instant is T0.
events: The owner submits a correction that changes the project.
Registry accepts it, moves the revision and writes the correction's audit entry in the same transaction.
outcomes: The project and audit entry both record one shared instant T1.
The project records T1 while the audit entry records a later reading T2.
witness.observer: The owner comparing the project card with the audit log sees whether the instants are identical.

open_points.subject: Required-test coverage for A04-3 and A04-6
open_points.text:
A correction that changes a project moves its revision by exactly one and
   sets its last-changed instant to the current instant; a correction that
   changes a Customer, and a mark that restricts it, each move the Customer's
   revision by exactly one and set its last-changed instant to the current
   instant; a correction of either that changes nothing leaves its revision
   and its last-changed instant where they were. Shows A04-3, A04-6.
open_points.question: Must the witness show A04-3 and A04-6 for every applicable revision-moving or no-change action, or are project correction, Customer correction, restriction and no-op correction intended as representative samples? The item does not say what must be shown for lifting a restriction, ending or resuming a relationship, or their no-change forms.
options: Require coverage of every action to which the universally quantified invariants A04-3 and A04-6 apply.
Declare the listed actions representative and leave the other transitions untested by A04's witness.
Name a smaller explicit action set as the domain of A04-3 and A04-6.
open_points.default_guess: Require a parameterized witness covering every applicable action, including lifting, ending and resuming, with changed and no-change cases where each is admissible.

set_aside.subject: A03-2 non_editable domain
set_aside.question: Which exact facts belong to non_editable(p): only identity, status, marks, created instant and request id, or every fact not supplied by the correction, including revision and last-changed instant?
options: Only the stable facts enumerated by A03 rule 3; revision and last-changed follow A04.
Every fact not supplied as editable input, which makes A03-2 incompatible with A04-3 for a changing correction.
set_aside.default_guess: Define non_editable(p) as exactly identity, status, marks, created instant and request id, excluding revision and last-changed instant.
